# Genesis Apocryphon Column 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 19 | **Condition:** Well preserved; major sections legible

---

**19:1** Then I, Abram, traveled through the-land, to-its-length and-to-its-breadth, and-I-went looking-at-it.

**19:2** And-I-went from-the-river Gihon to-the-shore of-the-sea, and-I-went along-the-Great-Sea

**19:3** until I-reached the-mountain of-the-Bull. And-I-traveled from-the-shore of-this-great-salt-sea

**19:4** and-I-went along the-mountain of-the-Bull eastward through-the-breadth of-the-land

**19:5** until I-reached the-river Euphrates. And-I-traveled along-the-Euphrates until I-reached the-Red-Sea in-the-east.

**19:6** And-I-went along-the-Red-Sea until I-reached the-tongue of-the-Reed-Sea.

**19:7** And-God said to-me: To-you I-shall-give all-this-land, and-to-your-seed after-you I-shall-give-it;

**19:8** they-shall-possess-it forever. And-I-shall-multiply your-seed as-the-dust of-the-earth

**19:9** which no-man can-number. Your-seed also shall-not be-numbered.

**19:10** Rise-up, walk-about in-it, to-its-length and-to-its-breadth, and-look, for-to-you I-shall-give-it.

**19:11** Then I, Abram, went to-dwell by-the-oaks of-Mamre which are in-Hebron.

**19:12** And-I-built an-altar there and-I-offered upon-it a-burnt-offering and-a-grain-offering

**19:13** to-the-God Most-High. And-I-ate and-I-drank there, I and-all the-men of-my-household.

**19:14** And-I-sent and-I-invited Mamre and-Ornam and-Eshkol, the-three brothers-of the-Amorite, my-friends, and-they-ate together with-me.

**19:15** Before-these-days there-came a-famine in-all-the-land. And-I, Abram, went-down to-Egypt

**19:16** and-I-entered-into Egypt. And-I-dwelt in-the-land of-Egypt five years before-my-wife was-taken from-me.

**19:17** Now the-king of-Zoan gave to-us much grain and-much oil and-much wine,

**19:18** and-I had-a-dream. In-my-dream I-saw a-cedar-tree and-a-palm-tree growing from-one-root.

**19:19** Men came and-they-sought to-cut-down the-cedar-tree and-to-leave the-palm-tree by-itself.

**19:20** But the-palm-tree cried-out and-said: Do-not cut-down the-cedar, for-we-are-both from-one-root.

**19:21** And-the-cedar was-spared on-account-of the-palm-tree.

**19:22** I-awoke from-my-sleep in-the-night and-I-said to-Sarai my-wife:

**19:23** I had-a-dream, and-I-am fearful on-account-of this-dream. She said to-me: Tell-me your-dream.

**19:24** And-I-told-her and-she-understood its-meaning and-she-said to-me:

**19:25** They-will-seek to-kill me and-to-spare you. This only is-the-mercy which you-must do for-me:

**19:26** in-every-place where-we-come, say of-me: He is my-brother. And-I-shall-live on-account-of-you,

**19:27** and-my-life shall-be-saved because-of-you.

**19:28** And-Abram wept on-account-of Sarai his-wife that-night, weeping bitterly.

**19:29** And-I-prayed that-night and-I-entreated and-I-asked, and-I-said in-my-grief:

**19:30** Blessed are-You, O-God Most-High, my-Lord, over-all the-ages.

**19:31** For-You are Lord and-Master over-all, and-over-all the-kings of-the-earth You-rule

**19:32** to-execute-judgment upon-all of-them. Now I-make-my-complaint before-You

**19:33** against Pharaoh Zoan, king of-Egypt. For-my-wife has-been-taken from-me by-force.

**19:34** Execute-judgment upon-him for-me, and-show-forth Your-mighty-hand against-him and-against all-his-house.

---

*EMET notes: Column 19 is well preserved and marks the beginning of the best-surviving section of the Genesis Apocryphon. The text is in first-person Aramaic, with Abram narrating. The cedar-and-palm dream (19:18-21) is unique to this text and has no parallel in Genesis. "The mountain of the Bull" (tur tora) is likely Mount Taurus. Construct chains and verbal sequences preserved with hyphens throughout. "God Most High" renders El 'Elyon.*
